the-registry-page-plan.text: Read the spec for the story and the requirements, the touch list for every file, and the tasks for the commit boundaries. Base main at e7b55ac9.

strategy.text: singular registry describe reuses what inspect already does and adds nothing to the chain side. It selects the registry from its token and the release, runs the same public replay, reads the live request outputs, and renders one value two ways. Three things are new: the replay reports the facts the page needs (create transaction, fold transactions in order, the keys the folds named); a pure page value with a text and a JSON rendering; and the command that composes them. The two-actor journey then reads the page for real and its two waiting rows pass.

class-and-staffing.text: The command is new product behavior, so the full path applies: one writer, a mute persistent auditor, the existing CI commands as the gate. Staffing is the operator's: ticket owner Claude Sonnet 5.5 at extra-high effort; writer Muse, one at a time; auditor Grok 4.7 at high effort, persistent and mute, an alarm that blocks only with a concrete failure scenario. No gate-author pair and no other seat: the gate below is written by the ticket owner from the workflow files, one hosted command per acceptance line.

slices.text: Writer time in minutes, about 250 in all. Cut rule: if slice 5 ends past minute 210, slice 6 moves to the second pull request below; nothing else moves. Applied: slice 5 ended past minute 210, so slice 6 is in the second pull request, which holds slices 6, 7 and 8.

gate.text: Written by the ticket owner from the workflow files. Each line is an existing command; the budget is 25 minutes per candidate without the journey. The journey is the hosted job at the pushed head: the writer runs it locally while developing slice 4 and it is not a repeated gate. just ci runs once, on the final candidate.

invariants-the-writer-proves-each-seen-t.text: Invariants the writer proves, each seen to fail first.

model-rows.text: The JSON rendering is a receipt: command is describe, outcome is success, then the sections registry, release, rules, state and provenance. state has root, activeKeys, terminalKeys, foldsSinceCreate, createTransaction, lastFold (null when there is none), stateOutput and pendingRequests, whose entries are the objects inspect prints for pending requests. The journey reads these names.

Data rules: the page holds no timestamp, tip or session identity. Pending requests are ordered by request output reference. Active plus terminal plus other counts equal the distinct named keys. The last fold is the final element of the fold list and is absent exactly when the list is empty.

live-lanes-and-constraints.text: Single-threaded rule: describe starts no thread. Reads only: no signing, no submission, no write under a state directory. Files held by live lanes stay out of the touch list: Session.hs, Receipt.hs, Reconcile.hs, the fold builder, Create.hs, Deploy.hs, Recorder.hs, Terminal.hs, flake.nix, registry.yml and anything under onchain/. Three shared files meet other lanes and are marked in the touch list: Command.hs and singular-registry.cabal (other lanes edit both) and Inspect.hs (the related inspect ticket). A new runnable file gets its hosted job in this pull request: the new specs run in the existing focused suite step, the journey is an existing job.
